mapper.select: SELECT user_name FROM sys_user WHERE utopia_uuid = #{actorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_events (id, kb_id, actor_id, action, target_kind, target_id, detail, client_ip, user_agent, actor_label) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{detail}::jsonb, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{actorLabel})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.action, e.target_kind, e.target_id, e.detail, e.actor_id, u.nick_name AS actor_name, e.created_at FROM audit_events e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = e.actor_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (#{action}::text IS NULL OR e.action LIKE #{action} || '%') AND (#{actor}::uuid IS NULL OR e.actor_id = #{actor}) AND (#{since}::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at >= #{since}) AND (#{until}::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at < #{until}) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (#{action}::text IS NULL OR e.action LIKE #{action} || '%') AND (#{actor}::uuid IS NULL OR e.actor_id = #{actor}) AND (#{since}::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at >= #{since}) AND (#{until}::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at < #{until})
SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_events WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY 1
